occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: The director and two caregivers are missing the CPR and First Aid Certifications.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director received 5 of the 30 clock hours of required annual training for the 8/22-8/23 training year. The director will need to receive 25 clock hours of make-up training that will not count towards the current training year. The following trainings are missing: Child growth and development; Guidance and discipline; Age-appropriate curriculum; Teacher-child interaction; Serving children with special care needs; Child maltreatment; Shaken baby syndrome; Safe sleep; brain development; Emergency preparedness; Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases; Administering medication; Preventing and responding to emergencies; Understanding building and physical premises safety; Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.    This was corrected when the caregiver removed the child from the sleeping device and placed the infant in a crib.

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A spray bottle with a clorox solution was within reach of children in the pre-k and school age classrooms.  This was corrected when the teachers place the products out of reach of the children.    A storage hallway with chemicals and cleaning supplies was observed having open access to the school age classroom.  There was no door to prevent access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation: One of the vans used for transportation did not have a first aid kit.    This was corrected when a caregiver was able to provide one and place it in the van.
